title: Adaptive lanes quarterly roadmap for Hosted API & Model Catalog
creator: Maya Patel
description:
Goal: Produce an actionable quarterly roadmap that aligns Hosted API endpoint launches and model-catalog onboarding into four adaptive lanes (Core Stability, Throughput/Cost, New Capabilities, Enterprise Controls). The doc will define which initiatives land in each lane, week-by-week delivery windows, gating criteria for model releases, OKR mapping, and a lightweight escalation protocol for high-impact regressions.

Scope: planning artifacts for Q2 hosting and model catalog efforts only (not Dedicated or Private platform-specific ops). Work includes stakeholder alignment sessions, lane assignment matrix, dependency map, risk mitigation playbook, and a roll-forward plan for schedule slips.

Success metrics: lane-specific commitments signed off by ENG/Design/SRE/DS leads, a validated canary criterion set for each model family, and a launch calendar published to the Console release pipeline and Confluence with connected GitHub milestones.
acceptance_criteria: Lane assignment spreadsheet with owners and target milestones published in Confluence
OKR map linking each initiative to 1-2 measurable outcomes (latency P50/P95, token cost, model-quality regression rate)
Gating checklist for hosted-model onboarding including eval-suite pass rates and infra smoke-tests
Cross-team dependency map with at least provisional dates and mitigation owners
Published launch calendar integrated with Console release pipeline and annotated with fallback models
risks: Model regressions discovered late in canary causing rollbacks and delivery slippage
Capacity shortages in Dedicated pools causing hosted endpoints to miss SLOs
Misalignment on priority between growth-driven feature launches and platform stability work
Insufficient eval coverage for niche enterprise prompts leading to undetected quality regressions
decisions: Adopt four adaptive lanes (Core Stability, Throughput/Cost, New Capabilities, Enterprise Controls) instead of rigid tranches to allow mid-quarter rebalancing
Require an eval-suite pass (>=95% on critical prompt set) and infra smoke test before any model is promoted from canary to GA
Use short 2-week review checkpoints for lane re-prioritization tied to OKR progress checkpoints
tasks: Host stakeholder alignment workshop (PM/Eng/SRE/Design/DS) - owner: Maya
Draft lane assignment matrix and circulate for review - owner: Liam
Assemble model-specific canary criteria templates (eval sets, traffic percentage, SLO thresholds) - owner: DS lead
Integrate launch calendar with Console release pipeline and add model tags - owner: Eng infra
Prepare fallback model mapping (compatible variants + quantization profiles) - owner: Runtime team
